verdict.rationale: Evidence confirms CUDA acceleration exists (comm-1 references setting CUDA acceleration) and Apple Silicon MLX acceleration is well-supported (comm-12, docs-29 mentions llama.cpp/MLX backends), but AMD/Radeon support is explicitly called out as lacking a 'just works' solution (comm-20), showing vendor-specific kernel support is uneven across GPU vendors. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of AMD/ROCm acceleration kernels, corroborated hands-on evidence that AMD GPUs get comparable vendor-specific optimization, and coverage of 'other' GPU vendors beyond NVIDIA/Apple.
